name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Endfeldhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Endfeldhof is situated in the charming village of Erl in the Tyrolean Unterland, offering self-contained holiday flats on an active working farm. Each apartment includes a private kitchen and bathroom, ensuring complete independence during your stay. Erl is renowned for its iconic Passion Plays and vibrant music festivals hosted in the modern Festspielhaus. The picturesque setting offers superb hiking throughout the Kaiser Mountains and adjacent Bavaria. Located in a tranquil position on the edge of the village, the farm boasts stunning Alpine views, opportunities to experience everyday farm life, and fresh local produce.
